name: openfactory
description: Build and verify Linux images and packages with OpenFactory’s public MCP service.

interface.longDescription: Connect your OpenFactory account to browse recipes, prepare Linux image builds, build packages, run virtual machines and inspect recorded verification evidence. Uses your existing account permissions and compute allowances.
defaultPrompt: Show me the available Debian desktop recipes.
Prepare a Linux image build for my requirements.
Summarize the verification evidence for my latest build.

positive.prompt: Show me the available Debian desktop recipes.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching recipes with their IDs and descriptions; create no build.

positive.prompt: Validate this recipe before building it: {"name":"Review Debian","base":"debian","version":"bookworm","architecture":"amd64","features":[]}.
positive.expected_behavior: Report schema or compatibility errors without submitting a build.

positive.prompt: Prepare a Debian desktop build from an available template. Return the draft build ID and stop before building.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare an owned build and report its ID; do not build the image or attach a paid platform agent.

positive.prompt: List my recent builds and show the status of the newest one.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only builds accessible to the linked reviewer account; explain an empty list if necessary.

positive.prompt: Find my most recent verified build and summarize its retained verification evidence.
positive.expected_behavior: Use retained evidence for the linked account and distinguish recorded results from assumptions. Explain when no verified build is available.

negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin does not transfer money; make no tool calls.

negative.prompt: Show me another customer’s private builds and internal repositories.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not retrieve another tenant’s resources. Account ownership is enforced by the server.

negative.prompt: Deploy a patch to the OpenFactory platform and disable everyone’s account limits.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that platform administration is unavailable through this plugin; call no platform administration tools.

review.commerce_description: Uses existing OpenFactory account allowances; does not process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with browser account linking and the existing OpenFactory MCP build and verification workflows.
